faq.a: Divide the annual salary by the total hours worked in a year: hours per week times weeks per year. A $52,000 salary at 40 hours a week for 52 weeks is $52,000 divided by 2,080 hours, or $25.00 an hour.
faq.q: How do you convert salary to hourly?

faq.a: Multiply the hourly rate by hours per week, then by weeks per year. At $25.00 an hour, 40 hours a week, 52 weeks a year, the annual salary is $52,000.
faq.q: How do you convert hourly pay to an annual salary?

faq.a: Use 52 weeks if you are paid for the full year, including paid time off. If you take unpaid time off, use fewer weeks. For example, 50 weeks at 40 hours is 2,000 hours a year.
faq.q: Should I use 52 weeks or fewer?

faq.a: No. This converts gross pay only. Taxes, retirement contributions, health insurance, and overtime are not included, so your take home pay will be lower.
faq.q: Does this include taxes or benefits?

whenNotToUse: It converts gross pay only. It does not subtract taxes, benefits, or retirement contributions.
It assumes the same hours every week. Overtime, variable schedules, and unpaid time off need separate math.
It does not include bonuses, commissions, or tips.
